turns.query: Is the £30 extra for the Sony WH-CH735N worth it just for the longer battery life, or does it have better sound quality or ANC performance compared to the CH720N?
turns.response:
Based on the product details and Q&A I have, the main clear upgrade on the WH-CH735N is battery life.
Feature	Sony WH-CH720N	Sony WH-CH735N
Price	£69.99	£99.99
ANC	Active noise cancellation	Active noise cancellation
Battery life	Up to 35 hours	Up to 75 hours, or 50 hours with noise cancelling on
Sound quality evidence	Clear, reliable call quality; natural vocals and balanced sound	No specific comparative detail available
ANC performance evidence	Good ANC; works even on wired connection	"Sony's best CH-series noise-cancelling yet"
In summary:
Choose the WH-CH720N if you want good ANC for less money. The product details and Q&A support that it has active noise cancelling and clear, balanced sound.
Choose the WH-CH735N if you want much longer battery life and Sony's own product wording about stronger CH-series noise cancelling.
I can't confirm a sound quality leap from the information available, so if you're deciding purely on sound, the safer view is that the CH735N's extra £30 is mainly paying for the battery and upgraded CH-series ANC claim, not a clearly documented jump in audio quality.
